失效」，到点执行，不看心情。把决策从持有中剥离出来，你才能看清

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Your Brain Is Lying to You When You’re Stuck Holding a Position
translatedData.subTitle:
What do people down 50% on a position look at? The “all-time high,” thinking to themselves: “If it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Be careful: this thought is all attachment, no logic. The market doesn’t know your entry price,
it only responds to supply and demand in the present.

Once you’re stuck holding a position, you’ll automatically seek out good news and block out bad news. This is called confirmation bias. You’ll think,
“This time is different.” Those five words have burned more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is actually simple, but hard to put into practice: before opening a position, write down “under what circumstances the rationale for this trade
no longer holds,” then act when the time comes, regardless of how you feel. Separate your decision-making from holding the position, and you’ll be able to see clearly.

translatedData.content:
Opening a prediction market app in Utah and trading sports-related contracts could now expose the platform and its founders to felony charges for “online gambling”—and federal regulatory approval may not protect them from state prosecutors.

Around October 28, Utah Attorney General Derek Brown filed criminal charges against prediction market platform Kalshi (KalshiEX) and its co-founders, Tarek Mansour and Luana Lopes Lara. Public documents list about 14 counts in total: 13 for promoting online gambling under state law (on the level of third-degree felonies), plus one count of “pattern of unlawful activity” (on the level of a second-degree felony).

A few points that directly affect ordinary users 👇

🔹 Prosecutors say that from September 13 to 26, an undercover officer using a Utah identity placed 12 trades on sports-related event contracts on Kalshi (including American football, baseball, the NHL, and more), totaling about $114. They cite this as evidence that the platform offered gambling to state residents.
🔹 A common defense from Kalshi is that event contracts are designated contract market products regulated by the federal Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC), so state gambling laws should not apply. The CFTC has also sued Utah, seeking to prevent the state from enforcing its laws against federally approved products.
🔹 The state’s position is firm: to Utah residents, these “event contracts” are no different in substance from traditional sports betting. A federal judge also previously declined to fully block the state’s enforcement options, so the attorney general has turned to criminal charges.
🔹 What this means for you: If you’re in Utah (or your IP address or payment information points to a state where gambling is prohibited), don’t assume that “having a CFTC license means it’s automatically safe.” A state attorney general can go after the platform directly under local gambling laws—and even target its founders personally. Whether you can use prediction markets depends on both federal approval and the gambling restrictions in your state.

Put simply: this isn’t “another exchange getting called in for questioning.” It’s an escalation in which “the state is treating sports prediction market contracts as felony gambling.” If you’re in a state where gambling is prohibited, check whether these contracts are allowed locally before thinking about odds and liquidity.

Do you think prediction markets should be regulated federally, or should states be able to prosecute them directly under gambling laws?

说白了：这不是「又一家交易所被约谈」，而是「州要把预测市场体育单按赌博重罪办」的升级。身在禁赌州的朋友，先核清当地能不能碰这类合约，再谈赔率和流动性。

📰 USDD’s Impressive Data: A Tailwind for Stablecoins or a Battle for Existing Market Share?

Last Wednesday, stablecoin USDD released its Q3 financial report, showing a healthy financial position, with key metrics such as circulating supply and total value locked (TVL) continuing to grow. Its ecosystem is also expanding, with more cross-chain support and DeFi integrations creating additional use cases for users. As an overcollateralized stablecoin, USDD is seeking a balance between stability and utility. For the crypto market, USDD’s strong performance could signal intensifying competition in the stablecoin sector, with potential ripple effects for other stablecoins.

Why does this news matter?

USDD’s strong financial report first shows that the stablecoin market is still growing, with overcollateralized stablecoins in particular attracting more users and capital. Two deeper trends are behind this: first, demand for stability in the crypto market persists, especially when the broader market is volatile; second, multichain support and DeFi integrations demonstrate the resilience of the stablecoin ecosystem, making stablecoins more than just simple tools for transferring value. USDD’s growth suggests that this sector is no longer dominated by dollar-backed stablecoins, as more players enter the market.

The impact on the market landscape can be seen on several levels. On the one hand, USDD’s expansion could accelerate the concentration of the stablecoin market and put competitive pressure on established stablecoins such as Tether. On the other hand, if ecosystems around stablecoins like this can continue to attract nontraditional capital, such as funds from wealth management users, they could indirectly bring new capital into the crypto market as a whole. Historically, periods of rapid stablecoin growth have often coincided with bull markets for major assets such as ETH. But USDD’s strong performance this time is driven more by technical improvements than by a macro bull market, suggesting its impact may be structural rather than cyclical.

Impact on the market

In the short term, USDD’s financial report could boost confidence in the stablecoin sector among crypto market participants. In particular, some capital seeking a safe haven may shift toward overcollateralized options such as USDD. However, the direct impact on BTC/ETH is limited, since USDD’s ecosystem growth is mainly about reallocating existing capital. In the long term, if stablecoins can continue to attract mainstream users through technological upgrades, they could provide a structural tailwind for liquidity in the crypto market. In the short term, however, this is more likely to involve existing capital rotating between stablecoins and DeFi.

Trading outlook

USDD’s financial report is more significant for the stablecoin sector, where it signals intensifying competition. As for BTC/ETH, the broader market is still undergoing a correction, and the positive news around USDD is largely sentiment-driven and unlikely to directly trigger a major price rally. If more capital shifts from dollar-backed stablecoins to overcollateralized options such as USDD in the future, it may be worth watching for changes in the sources of new capital entering the crypto market. For now, however, USDD’s breakthrough is more about the survival of the fittest within its sector, with limited implications for BTC/ETH.

This view is invalidated if regulators suddenly tighten restrictions on the operations of all stablecoins.

📰 USDD数据亮眼，稳定币赛道是利好还是存量博弈？

上周三，稳定币USDD发布Q3财报，显示其财政状况良好，关键指标如流通供应量、锁仓总价值（TVL）持续增长。同时生态系统也在扩展，跨链支持、DeFi集成增多，为用户创造了更多使用场景。作为超额抵押型稳定币，USDD试图在稳定性与实用性间找到平衡点。对加密市场而言，USDD的亮眼表现可能意味着稳定币赛道竞争加剧，对其他稳定币或产生连锁影响。

为什么这条新闻重要？
USDD的亮眼财报首先说明稳定币市场仍在持续成长，尤其是超额抵押型稳定币正在吸引更多用户和资金。这背后有两大深层逻辑：第一，投资者对加密市场稳定性的需求持续存在，尤其是在整体市场波动时；第二，多链和DeFi集成展示出稳定币生态的韧性，使其不只是简单的价值转移工具。USDD的增长意味着这个赛道不再由美元稳定币垄断，更多玩家正在入场。

对市场格局的影响体现在几个层面：一方面，USDD的扩张可能加速稳定币市场的集中度，对Tether等老牌稳定币构成竞争压力；另一方面，如果这类稳定币生态能持续吸引非传统资金（如理财用户），可能间接为整个加密市场带来增量。历史来看，稳定币的快速成长期往往伴随着ETH等主流币种的牛市，但此次USDD的亮眼更多来自技术优化而非宏观牛市驱动，这意味着其影响可能是结构性的而非周期性的。

对市场的影响
短期内，USDD的财报可能提振加密市场对稳定币赛道的信心，尤其是那些寻求避险的资金可能会分流到USDD等超额抵押品种。但对BTC/ETH的直接影响有限，因为USDD的生态增长更多是存量资金的重新分配。长期来看，如果稳定币能通过技术迭代持续吸引主流用户，可能对加密市场的流动性产生结构性利好，但短期内更可能是存量资金在稳定币和DeFi之间的轮动。

操作思路
USDD的财报对稳定币赛道意义更大，意味着这个细分领域竞争正在升温。对BTC/ETH而言，目前市场整体仍在调整，USDD的利好更多是情绪层面，不会直接推动价格大幅上涨。如果未来看到更多资金从美元稳定币转向USDD这类超额抵押品种，可能需要关注加密市场的增量资金来源变化。但现阶段，USDD的突破更多是赛道内的优胜劣汰，对BTC/ETH的启示有限。

    My partners and I completely avoided the recent Binance black swan event! We learned our lessons the hard way through years of battle-tested experience. I feel it’s important to share some of my experience and reflections with you:
      I don’t think the market lacks technical experts. What it lacks is clear-headed insight into market conditions, the rationality to sense market movements keenly, the resolve to cut losses decisively, the discipline to take profits in time, and the equanimity to avoid chasing highs, buying the dip, and patiently stay on the sidelines.
 
      I’ve been in crypto for over a decade. It was only after witnessing black swan events that went down in crypto history—the LUNA collapse, the May 19 crash, the FTX meltdown, and the liquidation of Three Arrows Capital—that I truly understood this saying.
     I used to be confident in my technical skills and always wanted to catch every market move, believing that understanding chart patterns and identifying support and resistance levels would guarantee a win.
It wasn’t until wave after wave of extreme market conditions hit that I realized: indicators can fail, and trends can reverse in an instant.
     No matter how beautiful the analysis, it can’t outweigh the wishful thinking that keeps you from cutting your losses. No matter how accurate your market forecast, greed can ruin it when you’re unwilling to take profits.
     The euphoria at market highs can easily make you lose your way, and trying to buy the dip too early on the way down is an even bigger trap.
     
 In a nutshell:

translatedData.content:
ECB’s Appia consultation receives 127 responses | ETH not designated as settlement chain | Wait for confirmation near $2,222

My stance is to watch cautiously and not directly translate “Europe is discussing tokenized finance” into “Europe is going to use Ethereum.” On October 28, the European Central Bank published the results of its public consultation on the Appia roadmap: 127 public- and private-sector institutions responded. Respondents broadly supported using central bank money as the foundation for tokenized finance and emphasized standards, interoperability, and public-private collaboration. The ECB also made clear that no design decisions have been made yet. The next step is to invite market participants to join working groups on topics such as deposits and payments, securities, and network governance. This is progress in policy and infrastructure discussions—not the selection of any particular public blockchain, and no ETH purchasing plan has been announced.

Why am I still watching ETH? If traditional assets eventually need to be issued, transferred, and settled across platforms, demand for on-chain accounts, smart contracts, and compliant interoperability services may grow, giving the Ethereum ecosystem a chance to compete. But there are many steps between “opportunity” and “cash flow accruing to ETH”: whether the ECB chooses a closed network, whether banks adopt permissioned chains, whether transactions take place on Ethereum mainnet or layer 2, and whether fees translate into demand for ETH all remain to be verified by future documents and real transaction data. Treating the 127 responses as a certain positive catalyst for ETH would be premature.

The market has not confirmed a strong move either. When I checked Kraken’s spot quote, ETH was around $2,222, with an intraday range of approximately $2,170 to $2,254. That range is simply a price snapshot at the time of observation; it does not prove that the Appia news caused the price movement. My short-term level to watch is whether the price can hold above $2,255, with $2,300 next. On the downside, I’m watching $2,200 first, then $2,170. If the price falls back below $2,170 and continues weakening, my current view that the market is “waiting for the structure to recover” would be invalidated. Even if it breaks above $2,255, I won’t chase if volume is insufficient or the price quickly returns to the range.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now. I would only consider a small spot long position, with no high leverage. I would enter with at most 1% of my total capital only if the price gets back above $2,255, holds that level on a retest, and trading activity is strong. The first target would be $2,300, where I would sell half; the second target would be $2,350, with the remaining position reduced in stages. After entry, if the price falls below $2,220, I would first sell half; if it drops below $2,200, I would close the entire position at a loss. If it loses $2,170 before entry, I would cancel the plan. If the ECB later clearly adopts another closed-network solution, the long-term thesis would also need to be reassessed. Waiting for confirmation is a discipline in itself.

#ETH
The above is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

欧央行Appia征询获127份回应｜ETH不是指定结算链｜2222美元附近先等确认

我的态度是谨慎观察，不把“欧洲讨论代币化金融”直接翻译成“欧洲要用以太坊”。欧洲央行10月28日公布Appia路线图公开征询结果：共有127家公共与私人部门机构回应，受访者普遍支持以央行货币为代币化金融的基础，并强调标准、互操作性及公私协作。央行同时写得很清楚：设计方案尚未作出决定，下一步才是邀请市场参与者进入存款与支付、证券、网络治理等专题工作组。这是政策与基础设施讨论的进展，不是某条公链中标，也没有公布ETH采购计划。

为什么我仍然关注ETH？若传统资产最终需要跨平台发行、转移与结算，链上账户、智能合约及合规互操作服务的需求可能扩大，以太坊生态有机会参与竞争。但“机会”与“现金流落到ETH”中间还有很多道门：欧洲央行是否选择封闭网络，银行是否采用许可链，交易是否进入以太坊主网或二层，费用是否传导为ETH需求，都有待后续文件和真实交易数据验证。把127份反馈当成ETH确定性利好，会过早定价。

市场也没有给出强势确认。我查看Kraken现货报价时，ETH约2222美元，日内区间约2170至2254美元；该区间只是观察时点的价格事实，不能证明Appia消息导致涨跌。我的短线观察位是2255美元上方能否站稳，其后看2300美元；下方先看2200，再看2170美元。若重新跌破2170并持续走弱，当前“等待结构修复”的判断就被推翻；即使突破2255，若放量不足或很快回到区间内，也不追。

如果是我自己交易：目前不参与，方向只考虑现货小仓位试多，不做高杠杆。只有价格重新站上2255美元、回踩仍守住且成交活跃时，才用总资金最多1%开仓；第一目标2300美元，触及后减半，第二目标2350美元，剩余仓位分批减仓。入场后若跌回2220美元下方先减半，跌破2200美元全部止损平仓；入场前先失守2170美元则取消计划。若后续欧央行明确采用其他封闭方案，长期叙事也要重估。等待确认，本身就是纪律。

#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Compounding Positions: Fortune Through Risk, or an Accelerator to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
The term “compounding positions” has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a big trend, compounding several times over
to turn it into dozens of times your original stake. Today, let’s talk about what those stories leave out.

【What Compounding Positions Does】Unrealized gains aren’t cashed out; instead, they’re treated as risk capital for new positions, which you keep opening,
It’s essentially using the market’s money to leverage up. As long as the trend continues, compounding can be incredible; when the trend stops, those unrealized gains can go
from tens of percentage points to zero in just one or two big bearish candles.

【The Mathematical Truth】The essence of compounding positions is “getting consecutive bets right.” If the win rate is 60%, the probability of winning four times in a row
is only 13%. Behind those posts you see about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

结构上更刺眼的是分化：BNB 跌幅明显大于 BTC，说明资金不只在砍大饼，也对平台代币定价更紧。周末美股休市，流动性会更薄；真正要盯的不是「收没收回 7.8」，而是低点有没有被二次下探、以及提款/冻结相关进展会不会再搅一次风险偏好。

我个人怎么读这个周五傍晚（仅观察，非投资建议）：

1. 把今天的 7.8 万当成「急跌后的喘息」，比当成「V 型已确认」便宜——尤其离白天高点还有一大截。
2. BNB 相对弱势值得单独记账：若它持续弱于 BTC，说明压力不完全是大盘 beta。
3. 周末别用白天的反抽替周末定价。顺序仍是：低点是否守住 → 周末有没有二次冲击 → 周一美股开盘再验风险偏好。

#eth  🤦‍♂️ A hacker managed to temporarily replace the code of one of Binance's hot wallets using EIP-7702 (a feature from the Ethereum Pectra upgrade). 

EIP-7702 allows a regular EOA wallet to temporarily act like a smart contract if it has a valid signature from its private key. The hacker obtained such a signature, set up delegation on his sweeper contract, and drained the funds (ETH + a bunch of tokens, including large amounts of stablecoins). 

➕ To increase his chances, he pre-packaged a batch of ~50 authorizations with consecutive nonces (without knowing the exact current value) and sent them all at once. The network accepted only the one whose nonce matched at the time of execution, discarding the rest.

translatedData.content:
Weekly recap: ETFs pulled in $424 million over three days, but Bitcoin still fell below $78,000

The market action this week was a bit of a mess. U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw net inflows for three consecutive days, from Monday through Wednesday: $110.3 million on the 26th, $176 million on the 27th, and $137.3 million on the 28th, adding up to $423.6 million, or about $424 million. Almost all of it went into BlackRock’s fund. The money really did come in, but the price didn’t seem to care. Bitcoin was still hovering around $81,000 on the 24th, but by today it had fallen to just over $77,000, down about 5% over seven days. Ether was even weaker, falling to around $2,200, down about 7.7% over seven days.

The midweek turning point was the Federal Reserve. According to the Fed’s published vote, rates were held steady at 3.75% to 4% on October 28, with a 10–2 vote—and the two dissenting votes favored a rate hike. Holding steady alongside dissenting votes calling for a hike came across as hawkish to the market. That same week, Alphabet reported third-quarter revenue of $127.58 billion, below expectations. Tech stocks fell first, and risk appetite weakened along with them. During Asian trading hours on the 29th, Bitcoin slid from just over $81,700 to around $79,800. According to CoinDesk’s figures, $356 million was liquidated across the market over the past 24 hours, with longs taking the biggest hit. Against that macro backdrop, the ETF inflows over those three days didn’t look like much.

The event that knocked the market into a hole on Friday was the Binance incident. On October 29, unusual withdrawals were detected from Binance’s hot wallet, and deposits and withdrawals were subsequently suspended. According to Binance’s preliminary update on the 30th, an attacker compromised a laptop belonging to an operations engineer, used it to access a service container, and submitted unauthorized withdrawal requests. The company said it had found no evidence so far that wallet private keys had been leaked. Binance estimates the impact at around $6.3 billion and says it has frozen about $3 billion. Estimates from on-chain analytics firms range from $5.9 billion to over $6.3 billion. Frozen funds are not the same as recovered funds, and the investigation has yet to reach a final conclusion. Binance says it will cover losses using its user protection fund and company funds. BNB took the most direct hit, falling more than 8% in 24 hours and briefly returning to around $694.

Also on the 29th, an incident involving a third-party service provider affected Polymarket’s international platform. Trading was temporarily limited to canceling orders, and transfer relays were suspended. The platform marked services as restored that afternoon. There’s no evidence in the public information linking the two incidents, so don’t make up a story about them being part of a coordinated attack.

Looking at the week as a whole, ETF inflows couldn’t support prices; the macro backdrop called the shots. The Binance incident is also a reminder of the other side of the equation: keeping your money on an exchange means letting someone else hold the keys. If an exchange runs into trouble, your coins may not be stolen directly, but suspended deposits and withdrawals and a price crash can still leave you taking the hit.

My view: next week, it all comes down to whether Bitcoin can get back above $80,000. If it can’t, the market will probably keep grinding between $76,000 and $80,000. Apart from a few altcoins bucking the trend, most followed the broader market this week. Before chasing a rally, ask yourself whether you can stomach another red candle.

Did you happen to need to move money when deposits and withdrawals were suspended this week?

#BTC #ETH #BNB #本周复盘 #Federal Reserve
—— Web3 Leek Kai

周中的转折点在美联储。按美联储公布的投票结果，10月28号利率按在3.75%到4%没动，投票是10比2，而反对的两票是想加息的。按兵不动配上要求加息的反对票，市场读出来的意思就偏鹰了。同一周，Alphabet三季报营收1275.8亿美元，不及预期，科技股先跌了一波，风险偏好跟着往下走。29号亚洲时段，大饼从8万1千7百多滑到7万9千8百附近。CoinDesk口径的过去24小时，全市场清算了3.56亿美元，多头是重灾区。ETF那三天的流入，在这种宏观风向面前显得有点不够看。

把周五砸出一个坑的，是币安那件事。10月29号，币安热钱包出现异常提币，随后暂停了充提。按币安30号的初步通报，一名运维工程师的笔记本电脑被攻破，攻击者借此进入服务容器、提交了未经授权的提币请求，官方称目前没有发现钱包私钥泄露的证据。币安自己估计的影响约63亿美元，已经冻结了约30亿美元，链上分析机构给的数在59亿到63亿多之间浮动，冻结的钱不等于已经追回的钱，调查也没出最终结论。币安表示会用用户保障基金和公司资金兜底损失。受冲击最直接的是BNB，24小时跌了8%以上，一度回到694美元附近。

同在29号，Polymarket国际平台也出了一起第三方服务商相关事件，交易一度只许撤单、转账中继暂停，当天下午标注恢复。两件事的公开信息里没有关联证据，别自己脑补成连环攻击。

把这周摊开看，ETF的钱没托住价格，宏观风向说了算。币安这件事提醒的另一面是，钱放在交易所，等于把钥匙交给了别人保管。交易所出事，你的币未必直接被盗，但充提一停、价格一砸，损失照样会落到你头上。

我判断，下周就看8万能不能站回去。站不回去，行情大概率继续在7万6千到8万之间磨。山寨币这周除了个别逆势的，大部分跟着大盘走，追高之前先想想自己能不能接受再来一根阴线。

这周充提暂停的时候，你有没有正好要动钱？

title: 🚨 ETHEREUM VALIDATOR SECURITY WARNING: A CERTIFICATE FLAW COULD HAVE PUT SOME ETH REWARDS AT RISK!
subTitle:
blockchain wasn’t hacked, but a security issue involving external certificate infrastructure exposed potential risks for certain validator configurations.
Here’s what happened. 👇
🔍 WHAT WAS DISCOVERED?

Researchers discovered that eight intermediate certificate-authority keys linked to India’s eMudhra could be recovered because of weak cryptography.

This created a risk that attackers could create fraudulent certificates and impersonate trusted external services.
⚠️ WHY DOES THIS MATTER FOR ETHEREUM?

Some Ethereum validators use external HTTPS services.
In vulnerable configurations, an attacker capable of intercepting network traffic could potentially impersonate those services and redirect certain validator rewards.
🛡️ WHAT HAS BEEN DONE?

Ethereum client developers have released security updates:
🔹 Teku 26.10.3 — October 27

🔹 Besu 26.10.2 — October 26
These Docker updates remove trust in the affected certificate roots.

Important: Operators using standalone installations may need separate Java runtime updates.

📊 IS ETHEREUM ITSELF AT RISK?

Not in the sense of a confirmed blockchain compromise.

✅ Default Teku mainnet configurations without HTTPS endpoints were not affected by this issue.

✅ No exploitation had been reported in the Teku security notice.

⚠️ Certain custom configurations still require attention.

💡 MY TAKE

This incident highlights something important about blockchain security:

A blockchain can have strong security at its core, while external infrastructure connected to it can still introduce vulnerabilities.

For $ETH , protecting validator infrastructure is just as important as maintaining reliable network software.

❓ Do you think crypto security discussions focus too much on blockchain technology and not enough on the infrastructure connected to it?

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Scaling In: How to Add to a Trend Trade as It Rises Without Blowing Up
translatedData.subTitle:
You’ve read the trend correctly and want to add to your position. How should you do it? Starting with a heavy position and adding to the max with unrealized profits makes you a
regular on the liquidation list. The right approach is called pyramid scaling in.

【Principle】Add less each time than you did the previous time. For example, start with 30%; after the first pullback is confirmed, add 20%,
Once the pullback is confirmed, add another 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position should be, keeping your cost basis weighted toward the lower levels so you can handle a pullback.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】A reverse pyramid (a small position at the bottom, getting larger and larger toward the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn profits into losses; once you panic, your whole strategy falls apart.

In-Depth Analysis of the Ethereum Market: Technicals and Capital Flows Amid the Impact of a Security Incident

I. Price Trend Analysis

As of 07:00 on October 30, 2026, Ethereum was trading at $2,240.99, down approximately 2.4% over the past 24 hours—a larger decline than Bitcoin’s. The price quickly retreated from above $2,300, briefly touching around $2,100, before consolidating in the $2,200–$2,250 range. Ethereum has been more directly affected by the security incident, as the attacker converted a large amount of stolen funds into more than 70,000 ETH, triggering severe selling pressure.

On the hourly candlestick chart, the latest five candles show narrow-range trading. The price fluctuated between $2,229 and $2,259, with volatility narrowing considerably. Trading volume surged to $40.54 million per hour during the decline, then contracted to $5.58 million, suggesting the market is waiting for a directional move. Notably, the price found support several times near $2,230, forming a short-term base.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

The moving average system shows the 7-hour moving average at $2,236.32, the 25-hour moving average at $2,286.13, and the 99-hour moving average at $2,322.45. The current price is below all the moving averages, indicating a bearish alignment. As with Bitcoin, the short-term moving averages are turning downward, and the gap with the medium- and long-term averages is widening. However, the 7-hour moving average has begun to flatten, hinting that short-term downward momentum may be nearing exhaustion.

For the MACD, the DIF line is at -25.80, the DEA line at -24.55, and the histogram at -1.25. The MACD is below the zero line, but the histogram’s negative value is narrowing rapidly, from an initial -7.70 to -1.25. This contraction is markedly faster than Bitcoin’s, suggesting that Ethereum’s downward momentum is fading more quickly. If the histogram turns positive in the next few hours, it would generate a bullish signal.

The RSI readings are 39.53 for the 6-period RSI, 38.14 for the 12-period RSI, and 39.00 for the 24-period RSI, all in relatively weak territory. Notably, the RSI previously hit an extreme oversold level of 13.7, then rebounded rapidly to above 50, indicating strong buying activity. For the KDJ indicator, the K line is at 58.90, the D line at 48.25, and the J line at 80.21. The three lines are diverging upward, indicating ample short-term rebound momentum.

The Bollinger Bands show an upper band at $2,381.96, a middle band at $2,276.76, and a lower band at $2,171.55. The current price is below the middle band but remains some distance from the lower band. The bands are narrowing, indicating declining volatility. A breakout above the middle band at $2,276.76 would confirm a short-term trend reversal.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

Ethereum market sentiment is under pressure from several factors. First, selling pressure from the 70,000 ETH linked to the security incident continues, with these tokens deposited in lending protocols and facing liquidation risk. Second, spot Ethereum ETFs recorded net outflows of $105.5 million on October 29, reflecting institutional investors’ risk aversion. Third, fear across the broader crypto market has spread to Ethereum, amplifying price volatility.

In terms of capital flows, Ethereum has seen significant net outflows, peaking at more than $160 million per hour. Such large-scale outflows are relatively rare in Ethereum’s history and reflect the level of panic among market participants. However, the price has found support near $2,200, indicating that long-term holders are willing to buy the dip.

Overall, Ethereum faces a need for a short-term technical recovery, but selling pressure stemming from the security incident could continue to limit the rebound. Investors should watch whether the $2,200 support holds and how the MACD histogram changes. A breakout above $2,280 followed by sustained trading above that level would confirm a short-term rebound trend. Compared with Bitcoin, Ethereum may have greater rebound potential, but also carries correspondingly higher risk.

一、价格走势分析

截至2026年10月30日07时，以太坊现货价格报2240.99美元，过去24小时下跌约2.4%，跌幅大于比特币。价格从2300美元上方快速回落，最低触及2100美元附近，随后在2200美元至2250美元区间震荡整理。以太坊受安全事件的影响更为直接，因为攻击者将大量被盗资金转换为超过70000枚ETH，引发了严重的抛售压力。

从小时级别K线来看，最近5根K线呈现窄幅震荡格局。价格区间在2229美元至2259美元之间，波动幅度明显收窄。成交量在下跌过程中放大至每小时4054万美元，随后萎缩至558万美元，表明市场正在等待方向选择。值得注意的是，价格在2230美元附近获得多次支撑，形成短期底部形态。

移动平均线系统显示，7小时均线报2236.32美元，25小时均线报2286.13美元，99小时均线报2322.45美元。当前价格运行在所有均线下方，形成空头排列。与比特币类似，短期均线向下拐头，与中长期均线的距离正在扩大。不过，7小时均线已经开始走平，暗示短期下跌动能可能接近枯竭。

MACD指标方面，DIF线报负25.80，DEA线报负24.55，柱状图值为负1.25。MACD处于零轴下方，但柱状图的负值正在快速收窄，从最初的负7.70缩小至负1.25。这种收窄速度明显快于比特币，暗示以太坊的下跌动能衰减更为迅速。如果柱状图能够在未来几小时内转为正值，将形成看涨信号。

RSI指标显示，6周期RSI报39.53，12周期RSI报38.14，24周期RSI报39.00，均处于偏弱区域。值得注意的是，RSI在前期曾触及13.7的极端超卖水平，随后快速反弹至50以上，显示出强烈的买盘介入。KDJ指标中，K线报58.90，D线报48.25，J线报80.21，三线呈现向上发散态势，短期反弹动能充足。

布林带指标显示，上轨报2381.96美元，中轨报2276.76美元，下轨报2171.55美元。当前价格运行在中轨下方，但距离下轨有一定距离。布林带开口正在收窄，表明波动率下降。如果价格能够突破中轨2276.76美元，将确认短期趋势反转。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场情绪受到多重因素压制。首先，安全事件导致的70000枚ETH抛售压力仍在持续，这些ETH被存入借贷协议，面临清算风险。其次，以太坊现货ETF在10月29日录得1.055亿美元净流出，显示出机构投资者的避险情绪。第三，整个加密市场的恐慌情绪传导至以太坊，放大了价格波动。

从资金流向来看，以太坊出现明显的净流出，峰值达到每小时1.6亿美元以上。这种大规模资金外流在以太坊历史上较为罕见，反映出场内资金的恐慌程度。不过，价格在2200美元附近获得支撑，显示出长期持有者的逢低吸纳意愿。

综合来看，以太坊短期面临技术面修复需求，但安全事件引发的抛售压力仍可能制约反弹空间。建议投资者关注2200美元支撑位的有效性，以及MACD柱状图的变化。如果价格能够突破2280美元并站稳，将确认短期反弹趋势。与比特币相比，以太坊的反弹弹性可能更大，但风险也相应更高。

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Rule: Why You Need to Stay in the Game to Last
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
shouldn’t exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means losing no more than 200 U on a single trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
With a drawdown of only 20%, a few winning trades can get your account back on track. But if you go all-in every time and lose 30%,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You’d need to nearly double it just to break even—mathematically, you’re pretty much done for.

【How to apply it】It’s not “keep your position size below 2%.” It’s “make sure the amount you lose if this trade hits its stop-loss
doesn’t exceed 2%.” So the right order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work out your position size.

📰 Why has CoinBase’s trading volume suddenly surged?

CoinBase just disclosed that its Q3 trading volume surged to $134.5 billion, giving it a 10.7% market share. What does it mean that this exchange has suddenly become so dominant? Simply put: it’s pushing its competitors into a corner.

Why does this news matter?
CoinBase’s sudden surge in volume is a two-way signal. On one hand, competition among exchanges has shifted from a race for quantity to a price war. CoinBase’s ability to stand out shows that it has found a differentiated path to survival. On the other hand, the US is one of the world’s most active crypto trading markets, and a transmission channel is taking shape: domestic capital pulling out of CoinBase → selling pressure on BTC. A 10.7% share means that whenever the US market fluctuates, CoinBase has the capacity to amplify market sentiment.

Market impact
In the short term, CoinBase’s surge in volume could increase BTC volatility. Historical data shows that when an exchange’s market share exceeds 10%, its trading volume can enter a self-reinforcing positive feedback loop. Here’s how the mechanism works:
- When institutional funds enter the market through CoinBase, they tend to favor more liquid BTC/ETH
- A 10.7% share is enough to reach a “network-effect tipping point,” prompting users of other exchanges to follow
However, note that if there’s a wave of withdrawals from exchanges (for example, if users start withdrawing fiat due to regulatory concerns), this positive feedback loop could suddenly break down.

Trading approach
CoinBase’s surge in volume looks more like a catalyst for a structural market move than a trend signal. If BTC can hold the key psychological level of $7,830 over the next two weeks, this catalyst could continue to gain momentum. But if US capital controls tighten (for example, if Q4 CPI exceeds expectations), CoinBase’s trading volume could suddenly contract, invalidating this assessment.

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Scaling Out of a Position: How to Lock In Profits While Letting Them Run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because cutting losses means overcoming fear, while taking profits means overcoming greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scaling-out method I've always used to take profits.

【Three stages】First stage: At the first target (for example, a 1:1 risk-reward ratio), sell a third of your position to lock in some profits,
At this point, the trade can no longer turn into a loss, and your mindset immediately changes. Second stage: At the second target
(for example, a 2:1 risk-reward ratio), sell another third. Third stage: Let the rest ride with a trailing stop; exit if it falls below the moving average
or the previous low, and let the profits run.

【Why this works】Exit your entire position too early and you'll kick yourself; hold the whole position and you often ride the elevator back down to square one.

translatedData.content:
One of the main culprits behind Binance’s massive theft this time: EIP-7702

Many people still don’t understand what EIP-7702 is:
Simply put, it gives externally owned accounts (EOAs)—that is, the wallet addresses we commonly use—additional capabilities. An EOA can temporarily delegate execution rights to a smart contract, allowing the contract to initiate transactions on behalf of that wallet.
Previously, an EOA could only sign with a private key and had no contract logic; 7702 is like adding an “代理 authorization switch” to a wallet.

⚠️ Attack chain breakdown:
The attacker infiltrated the system in advance and deployed a malicious asset-sweeping contract → tricked Binance’s hot wallet into signing, delegating the account’s execution rights to the malicious contract via EIP-7702 → directly called the contract’s built-in sweep function to transfer assets in bulk under the hot wallet’s identity.
The private key wasn’t directly leaked; the account signed away “permission to operate on its behalf” to code written by a bad actor.

EIP-7702 itself is a positive upgrade, intended to enable convenient features such as account abstraction, batch transactions, and session authorization. The risk has never been in the protocol itself, but in risk controls around the authorization process and signature verification.
Whenever signature verification fails to protect a new capability, convenience can turn into a massive vulnerability.

content:
币安这次巨额被盗，核心元凶之一：EIP-7702

很多人还没搞懂EIP-7702是什么：
简单说，它给以太坊普通外部账户（EOA，就是我们常用的钱包地址）增加了能力——EOA可以临时委托执行权给一份智能合约，让合约代替这个钱包发起交易。
以前EOA就是单纯私钥签名，没有合约逻辑；7702相当于给钱包装了一个“代理授权开关”。

⚠️ 本次攻击链路复盘：
攻击者提前渗透、部署恶意扫币合约 → 诱导币安热钱包签名，通过EIP-7702把账户执行权委托给恶意合约 → 攻击者直接调用合约内置的sweep扫币函数，以热钱包的身份批量转出资产。
不是私钥直接泄露，是账户把“代为操作的权限”签给了坏人写的代码。

EIP-7702本身是正向升级，用来实现账户抽象、批量交易、会话授权等便利功能；风险点从来不在协议本身，而在授权流程的风控、签名校验。
任何新能力，一旦签名校验失守，便利就会变成巨大漏洞。

The Fed kept interest rates unchanged on October 29, but markets had already priced in that expectation. Weak tech stocks pushed Bitcoin below $80,000. This suggests investors are now more concerned about inflation and an economic slowdown than whether the Fed will raise rates.

Why does this news matter?
The Fed holding steady is neutral in itself, but the market continued to fall, suggesting the Fed’s credibility is no longer as strong as it once was. Investors are now paying more attention to actual economic data than to central bank promises. Weak tech stocks mean money is flowing out of higher-risk areas, while Bitcoin, as a safe-haven asset, is performing poorly as risk aversion rises.

Market impact
For BTC/ETH, falling below $80,000 is a key psychological threshold. It means market sentiment has shifted from optimism to pessimism. In the short term, Bitcoin may continue to test $75,000, as there are currently no clear signs of a bottom. In the long term, if the Fed cannot control inflation, Bitcoin could fall as low as $70,000. Historical data shows that Bitcoin typically falls by more than 30% during Fed rate-hike cycles.

Trading outlook
I think Bitcoin is more likely to continue falling in the short term. This view would be invalidated if the employment data released by the Fed next week continues to worsen. The prediction that Bitcoin will fall below $75,000 is not valid.

subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where exactly should you place a stop loss? Here’s how I choose between technical levels and percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop loss matters more than whether you set one. Too close, and you’ll get stopped out every day; too far, and one loss can wipe you out.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%-2% of your capital. Simple and straightforward, suitable for beginners
It helps build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so you might place your stop right in someone else’s cluster of stop-loss orders.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place it where the market structure is invalidated: for a long position, below key support; for a short position, place it
above resistance. The logic is: if this level breaks, it means there’s evidence that I was wrong.
Work backward from your position size: if the stop distance is large, reduce your position size to ensure the loss on a single trade is still a percentage of your capital

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

translatedData.subTitle:
Last time, we covered how funding rates work. Today, let’s look at how to use them as a sentiment thermometer.

[State 1: Funding rates remain strongly positive] This means longs are overcrowded, with everyone borrowing money to go long. At this point, the market
is often accelerating toward a top, and a sharp “long squeeze” could happen at any moment. I’m not telling you to immediately
Instead, be especially cautious about chasing longs at this stage, and tighten your stop-loss.

[State 2: Funding rates remain negative] Shorts are overcrowded. Extremely negative funding rates often occur near panic-driven bottoms,
because everyone who was going to get out has already left, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies in the past began at times like this.

translatedData.content:
ETH fund data completed | $105.5 million in single-day outflows | I’ll wait for funding pressure to ease

My stance is cautious and watchful. I’m not going to chase ETH just because prices have rebounded. Farside’s page has now filled in the figures for each U.S. spot Ethereum fund on October 29, showing total net outflows of about $105.5 million. Earlier, ETHA and ETHB were still blank, so all that could be said then was that the completed figures were negative; blank entries absolutely could not be treated as zero. The figures now show outflows of about $71.7 million from ETHA and $15.6 million from ETHB, outflows of about $15.5 million from ETHE and $5.6 million from Grayscale Mini ETH, and an inflow of about $2.9 million into FETH. Not all products moved in the same direction, but the major outflows clearly outweighed the inflows. This table updates automatically, so any future revisions would need to be checked again.

Why does this affect the crypto market? Funds give traditional accounts a way to gain exposure to ETH prices. Sustained redemptions mean marginal demand through this channel is weakening, which could weigh on the prices the market is willing to absorb. But fund flows are not the same as ETH burned on-chain, and the $105.5 million figure cannot be mechanically equated with spot sell orders at a particular moment. Authorized participants’ creations and redemptions, hedging, and settlement of underlying assets all involve processes and time lags; on-chain activity in the Ethereum ecosystem, staking, and macro risk appetite can also affect prices. A single day of net outflows is not enough to conclude that institutional capital is withdrawing across the board over the long term.

The market has yet to confirm a turn toward strength. At the time of retrieval, Coinbase ETH/USD was around $2,241.59, with a 24-hour opening price of $2,310.36, a low of $2,170.03, and a high of $2,376.70. The current price has rebounded from the low but remains below the open. Farside’s table showed net outflows of about $21.4 million the previous day, rising to about $105.5 million on the 29th—a notable change at the margin. However, this price decline cannot be attributed solely to fund creations and redemptions; exchange security concerns and broader risk sentiment also played a part during the same period. Binance Square’s trending topics currently focus on subjects such as the FOMC, exchanges, and regulation. ETH does not appear on the six-hour most-searched list, so I won’t force unrelated labels into the discussion. In the short term, I’ll first watch whether $2,240 holds, then whether $2,310 can be reclaimed; $2,170 is the risk threshold for this observed range.

If I were trading myself, I would not try to catch the bottom right now. The only direction I’d consider is a small spot long, with no high leverage. For an entry, ETH would need to reclaim $2,310 and hold it on a retest, and the next fund data release would need to show no outflows of a similar scale. If those conditions are met, I’d use 2% of my total capital to buy in two tranches. My first target would be $2,377, where I’d take half off; I’d move the stop-loss up on the remainder and close the position if the price surged and then fell back below $2,310. If the price first breaks below $2,240 after entry, I’d stop out immediately. If it then breaks below $2,170, fund outflows remain large for consecutive days, or official data are materially revised, I’d abandon my bullish view and stop adding to the position. If the conditions aren’t triggered, I’ll stay in cash; I won’t present a plan as if it were an executed trade or a profit.

Sources: Farside Ethereum fund flows and publicly available Coinbase ETH/USD market data. #ETH
This is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH基金数据补齐｜单日流出1.055亿美元｜我先等资金压力缓解

我的态度是谨慎观望，暂时不因价格反弹就追买ETH。Farside页面现已补齐10月29日美国现货以太坊基金各分项，合计净流出约1.055亿美元。早些时候ETHA和ETHB仍为空栏，当时只能说已填部分为负，绝不能把空栏当作零；现在可见ETHA约流出7170万美元、ETHB约流出1560万美元，ETHE约流出1550万美元、Grayscale迷你ETH约流出560万美元，FETH约流入290万美元。内部不是所有产品同向，但主要负值明显大于正值。这张表自动更新，若日后修订需要重新核对。

这为什么影响加密市场？基金提供传统账户持有ETH价格敞口的入口，连续赎回意味着该渠道的边际需求走弱，可能压制市场愿意承接的价格。但基金流量不是链上ETH燃烧量，也不能把1.055亿美元机械等同于某一时刻的现货卖单。授权参与者的申赎、对冲与底层资产交割有流程和时间差；以太坊生态的链上活动、质押以及宏观风险偏好也会改变价格。仅看一天净流出，不足以得出长期机构资金全面撤离的结论。

市场尚未确认转强。Coinbase ETH/USD取数时约2241.59美元，24小时开盘2310.36美元，区间低点2170.03美元、高点2376.70美元。现价从低点回升，但仍在开盘之下。前一日Farside表列约2140万美元净流出，29日扩大到约1.055亿美元，边际变化值得重视；不过这段跌价不能只归因于基金申赎，同期还有交易所安全和整体风险情绪的扰动。币安广场热榜当前聚焦FOMC、交易所与监管等话题，六小时最常搜索列表没有ETH，我不硬套不相关标签。短线我先看2240美元能否守稳，再看2310美元能否收复；2170美元是这次统计区间的风险底线。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与抄底，方向只考虑现货轻仓试多，不开高杠杆。入场需要ETH先收复2310美元、回踩不破，而且下一次基金数据不再出现类似规模的流出；满足后用总资金2%分两笔买入。第一目标2377美元，触及先减半；余仓上移止盈，若冲高后重回2310美元下方就平仓。入场后若先跌破2240美元，立即止损；如果再跌破2170美元、基金连续大额流出或官方数据明显修订，就推翻偏多判断并停止补仓。条件没触发就保持空仓，不把计划写成成交或盈利。

以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours and is
a payment exchanged between longs and shorts. The exchange simply collects and distributes it; it doesn’t profit from it.

[Mechanism] Perpetual contracts have no settlement date. So how does the price stay in line with the spot price? That’s where the funding rate comes in:
When the contract price is above the spot price (bullish sentiment prevails) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is below the spot price (bears have the upper hand) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
Money flows between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

translatedData.content:
The most surreal thing that night Binance blew up wasn’t the liquidations—it was that ETH had two prices at once.

Ethereum developer Austin Griffith posted at the time: ETH was 2,200 on exchanges, 2,700 on AMMs. That post got over 50,000 views.

A $500 gap—by all rights, arbitrage bots should’ve rushed in to close it, but they didn’t. Someone in the comments said a $4K on-chain trade would cost $300 in gas; someone else said they couldn’t swap at all. In other words, the idea that “on-chain markets are always efficient” falls apart in extreme conditions: congestion fees put you off before the price gap does.

What’s more worth thinking about is why people were willing to pay so much for ETH on-chain. The main theory in the comments was that hackers were frantically converting their stolen funds into ETH, because USDT and USDC issuers can freeze those tokens, but ETH can’t be frozen. There’s no official confirmation of this, so I’m treating it as speculation. But the logic checks out: after Tether and Circle froze a large amount, the people holding whatever remained unfrozen had one priority—quickly turn it into an asset nobody can hit pause on.

Then look at all those posts on X saying “ETH 2250 accumulate here, target 2600+”—at least two accounts posted the exact same line. The moment you bought the dip at 2,250, someone on-chain was sweeping up ETH at 2,700, no matter the cost. The ETH you each had in mind wasn’t even the same thing.

Stablecoins being freezeable is thanks to regulation—and it’s also why hackers swap them out. Next time someone tells you “decentralized exchanges have more accurate prices,” ask them what gas cost that night.

#ETH #Binance

How can you verify a transaction using a block explorer?
Transfers within the same exchange are usually not recorded on-chain, so you won’t find a corresponding record in a block explorer.
The number of confirmations generally reflects how many blocks have been added to the chain after the transaction was included in a block. The higher the number, the less likely the transaction is to be reversed.

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

translatedData.title: Funding rates reveal bullish and bearish sentiment: learn to read three typical scenarios
translatedData.subTitle:
Last time, we covered how funding rates work. Today, we’ll talk about how to use them as a sentiment thermometer.

【State 1: Funding rates stay highly positive】This means longs are crowded, with everyone borrowing money to go long. At this point, the market
is often accelerating toward a top, and a sharp “long squeeze” could happen at any moment. That doesn’t mean you should immediately
shorting, but rather: be especially careful chasing longs during this phase, and tighten your stop-losses.

【State 2: Funding rates stay negative】Shorts are crowded. Extremely negative funding rates often appear near panic-driven bottoms,
because everyone who was going to run has already run, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies in the past began at times like these.

My stance is neutral but cautious: the upgrade roadmap is worth watching, but an unfinished testnet schedule should not be presented as a mainnet benefit already delivered. In an official announcement on October 22, the Ethereum Foundation made clear that the Glamsterdam upgrade, originally scheduled to activate on the Hoodi testnet on October 26, has been postponed, with no new activation block or time set. The announcement said core developers need to further study how EIP-8037 interacts with mainnet smart contracts. As a result, the previous execution-layer and consensus-layer activation configurations have been withdrawn, and the plan to raise Hoodi’s gas limit to 200 million at the same time has also been canceled. This concerns the Hoodi testnet, not an Ethereum mainnet halt; the Foundation also explicitly said that mainnet users and ETH holders do not need to take any action as a result.

Why am I still watching this? Glamsterdam involves execution efficiency and the scaling roadmap, and a testnet delay can change the pace of developer testing, node preparation, and how the market prices in future throughput. It reminds me not to price in a performance premium for ETH based on an outdated roadmap, as if those improvements had already been delivered. On the other hand, developers identifying a potential compatibility issue and postponing the upgrade is normal risk management. It does not directly imply that the same issue exists on mainnet, and it certainly does not mean all short-term price movements can be attributed to an announcement that was already made several days ago. The next things truly worth verifying are the Foundation’s revised Hoodi schedule, client release notes, and whether a mainnet activation time is eventually announced.

The full picture on fund flows matters too. Farside’s current table shows combined net outflows of about $105.5 million from U.S. spot ETH funds on October 29. The fields for each fund on October 30 still show dashes, so the page’s automatically calculated total of 0.0 does not confirm zero inflows. This means the latest institutional flow signal is temporarily unavailable. At the time of writing, Kraken ETH/USD was around $2,238, trading between $2,170 and $2,259 over the past 24 hours. The current price is near the top of that range, but has not broken through it. Price action only tells us that the market has yet to show strong follow-through; it does not prove that the postponement announcement caused this move.

I’m using $2,260 as the short-term confirmation level, $2,200 as the pullback level to watch, and $2,170 as the invalidation point for the current range. If the Foundation later announces a new testnet date, client versions complete validation, and ETH holds above $2,260 with sustained trading volume, I’ll become more confident in a rebound. If ETH breaks below $2,170, or the upgrade reveals broader mainnet compatibility risks, I’ll immediately drop my bullish bias. Both the event and the price action need to check out; neither can be used to validate the other.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t participate at this stage. I’d only prepare a small spot position long setup, with no leverage. I’d wait for an hourly close above $2,260, then enter only if a retest holds between $2,250 and $2,260. I’d allocate no more than 3% of my total capital, keeping the risk on the trade below 0.3% of my account based on the stop-loss distance. The first target is $2,290, where I’d take half off; the second is $2,330, where I’d exit the remaining position in stages. After entry, if the hourly close falls back below $2,230, I’d reduce the position by half; at $2,215, I’d stop out completely. If there’s no follow-through within two hours, I’d also close the position proactively. If the price breaks below $2,170 before entry, I’d cancel the entire plan and continue waiting for fund-flow data and a new official schedule.

我的态度是中性偏谨慎：升级路线可以关注，但不能把未完成的测试网安排写成主网利好落地。以太坊基金会10月22日官方公告明确，原定10月26日在Hoodi测试网激活的Glamsterdam升级已经延期，新的激活高度和时间尚未设定。公告说明核心开发者需要进一步研究EIP-8037与主网智能合约的相互作用，因此撤掉了原先的执行层、共识层激活配置，也取消了同一时点将Hoodi gas limit提升至2亿的计划。这里说的是Hoodi测试网，不是以太坊主网停摆；官方还明确表示主网用户和ETH持有人因此不需要采取操作。

为什么我仍然看这件事？Glamsterdam涉及执行效率和扩容路径，测试网推迟会改变开发者验证、节点准备和市场给未来吞吐量定价的节奏。它提醒我，不应因为一张旧路线图就提前给ETH加上已经实现的性能溢价。反过来，开发者发现潜在兼容性问题而推迟，也是正常的风险控制，不能直接推导出主网存在同样故障，更不能把短线价格波动全部归因于这条已发布多日的公告。下一步真正值得核实的是基金会新的Hoodi日程、客户端发布说明，以及最终是否给出主网激活时间。

资金端同样需要看完整数据。Farside当前表格显示10月29日美国ETH现货基金合计净流出约1.055亿美元；10月30日各基金栏位仍是横杠，页面自动合计的0.0并不是确认零流入。这说明最新机构资金信号暂时缺位。写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2238美元，过去24小时在2170至2259美元之间波动，现价靠近区间上沿，却还没有突破。价格表现只能说市场尚未给出强势延续，不能证明延期公告造成了这段走势。

我把2260美元作为短线确认位，2200美元作为回撤观察位，2170美元作为当前区间失效线。如果后续官方公布新的测试网时间、各客户端版本完成验证，同时ETH站稳2260并有持续成交，我会提高对反弹的信心；若跌破2170，或者升级再曝出更广泛的主网兼容性风险，偏多观察立即撤销。事件和价格必须同时过关，任何一条都不能替另一条背书。

如果是我自己交易，现阶段不参与，只准备现货小仓位做多计划，不用杠杆。等一小时收盘站上2260，再回踩2250至2260守住才入场，最多投入总资金3%，按止损距离将单笔账户风险压在0.3%以内。第一目标2290，到位减半；第二目标2330，剩余仓位分批平掉。入场后若小时收盘跌回2230先减半，跌至2215全部止损；若两小时内没有延续，也主动平仓。入场前若先破2170，整套计划取消，继续等基金流量和官方新日程。

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Have to Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours and is a payment between longs and shorts.
The two sides pay each other; the exchange simply collects and distributes the money—it doesn’t profit from it.

【Mechanism】Perpetual contracts have no settlement date, so how do their prices stay in line with spot prices? The answer is the funding rate:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (bullish sentiment is strong) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (bears are in control) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
Money flows between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

“Stable” doesn’t mean the dollar is guaranteed!

A dollar-pegged stablecoin targets a price of one dollar, but its trading price may deviate from that. The existence of reserves does not mean every holder can redeem dollars from the issuer without conditions.

Hypothetical example: You have 1,000 units that you bought for one dollar each. If their price falls to $0.97, their market value is $970—a $30 difference before fees. The number of units has not changed, but their value in dollars has fallen.

Selling the coin on an exchange at the market price is different from redeeming it with the issuer. Redemption may require specific eligibility, identity verification, a minimum amount, and fees; read the terms for the coin itself.

Before holding it, check three things: What are the reserves made up of? When was the latest independent report on them? And is direct redemption available to you?

A deviation alone does not prove the coin has collapsed, but it also does not guarantee that it will return to one dollar. Assess the reason, liquidity, and exit terms—not just the word “stable.”

Source: https://metamask.com/news/stablecoin-risks

«مستقرة» لا تعني أن الدولار مضمون!

العملة المستقرة المرتبطة بالدولار تستهدف سعر دولار واحد، لكن سعر تداولها قد ينحرف عنه. وجود احتياطيات لا يعني أن كل حامل يستطيع استرداد دولارات من المُصدر بلا شروط.

مثال افتراضي: لديك 1000 وحدة اشتريتها بدولار للوحدة. إذا أصبح سعرها 0.97 دولار، فقيمتها السوقية 970 دولارًا؛ فرق 30 دولارًا قبل الرسوم. عدد الوحدات لم ينقص، لكن قيمتها بالدولار انخفضت.

بيع العملة في منصة بسعر السوق يختلف عن استردادها من المُصدر. قد يتطلب الاسترداد أهلية محددة وتحققًا من الهوية وحدًا أدنى ورسومًا؛ اقرأ شروط العملة نفسها.

قبل الاحتفاظ بها، افحص ثلاثة أمور: ممّ تتكون الاحتياطيات؟ ما تاريخ أحدث تقرير مستقل عنها؟ وهل الاسترداد المباشر متاح لك؟

الانحراف لا يثبت وحده انهيار العملة، لكنه لا يضمن عودتها إلى دولار أيضًا. قيّم السبب والسيولة وشروط الخروج، لا كلمة «مستقرة» وحدها.

👀 Fresh off the crypto wire: Understanding EIP-7702: The Future of Ethereum Wallets

EIP-7702 is gaining attention as a significant Ethereum upgrade aimed at transforming how standard wallets function.

This proposal allows regular Ethereum wallets to temporarily act as smart contracts. title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant—it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to take action.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds required to open a position. For example, 10x leverage means 10% of the position value.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts displaying “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin level: When losses eat into the maintenance margin requirement, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of the position first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

The disruptive nature of this attack comes down to two key factors. ETH is around $2,238, down 4.8% in 24 hours and 6.9% over 7 days. The FNG is just 30, versus a weekly average of 47, and fear is still accelerating. In practical terms, exchange wallet users and smart account risk-control systems are affected first. Does the business logic hold up? When you see “smart wallet,” first ask who gets the permissions and who can revoke them.

ETH has retraced more than half its gains from the peak, and trading volume has surged unusually. Long-term interest and short-term panic selling may be converging at the same point. title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

Lisk chain shutdown approaching | ETH asset migration takes time | I remain measured on the mainnet impact

My priority is asset security first, trading opportunities second. Lisk’s official announcement states that Lisk Chain is scheduled to shut down on October 31, and that LSK, ETH, stablecoins, and DeFi positions held on-chain should be moved to Ethereum mainnet in advance. LSK already on Ethereum mainnet or held on exchanges is not subject to this migration requirement. The official guidance says a standard cross-chain withdrawal takes about 8 days, while unstaking before withdrawing takes about 11 days. It also warns that withdrawals in the seven-day challenge period may not be completed before the shutdown. This is Lisk’s own chain-exit arrangement; it does not mean Ethereum mainnet is shutting down, nor that all ETH holders need to move their assets. Lisk’s status page showed that mainnet and cross-chain components were still operational on October 30, so “scheduled shutdown” should not be described as an existing outage or as assets already lost.

The main effects on the crypto market are through infrastructure and liquidity, not automatic buying pressure for ETH. Cross-chain withdrawals require users to complete a proof and claim transaction on Ethereum mainnet, and they also need a small amount of mainnet ETH to pay fees. If liquidity providers exit pools, local trading depth could thin. Most assets moved to mainnet are simply changing where they are held or used; this does not mean there is new net demand. More concerning are fake migration links and scams asking for seed phrases. The official guidance explicitly says to access the bridge page only by checking the domain yourself. Anyone starting the process close to the deadline should rely on the latest official announcements and actual transaction status; the estimated 8 days should not be treated as a guarantee of when funds will arrive.

The price action also has not provided enough confirmation for me to chase. At around 12:40 a.m. Beijing time on October 31, ETH/USD on Kraken was about $2,229.6, below the day’s open of $2,248.9; the rolling 24-hour low was $2,170 and the high was $2,357.7. This wide range indicates that volatility risk remains high, and Lisk’s migration news cannot be treated as the sole cause of ETH’s current price movements. I’m watching to see whether $2,260 can be reclaimed and held, and only then would I look at $2,300–$2,350. The $2,170 level below is a clear risk reference. If the price breaks below $2,170 and the rebound lacks strength, my short-term bullish view is invalidated. These prices are exchange snapshots from that time and must be checked again before any trade is triggered.

If I were trading myself, I would stay out for now. Directionally, I would only consider a small spot position after confirmation, and would avoid high leverage. The conditions are for ETH to close an hourly candle above $2,260, hold above $2,245 on a retest, and for BTC not to lose its own key support at the same time. If those conditions are met, I’d use 3% of my account funds for the initial position, adding at most up to 6%. I’d take half off at $2,300 and close the remaining position at $2,350. If the price falls back to $2,210, I’d exit at a loss regardless of how the Lisk news is interpreted. If it first breaks below $2,170, I’d cancel the long plan and wait for a new structure to form. If no trigger occurs, I’ll remain in cash; I will not present a plan as though I have already bought or made a profit.

content:
Lisk链关停临近｜ETH资产迁移有时间差｜我对主网影响保持克制

我的态度是先看资产安全，再谈交易机会。Lisk官方公告写明，Lisk Chain计划在10月31日关停，链上持有的LSK、ETH、稳定币和DeFi头寸应提前转往以太坊主网；已经在以太坊主网或交易所的LSK不属于这项迁移要求。官方说明普通跨链退出约需8天，先解除质押再退出约需11天，并提醒处于七天挑战期的提款可能赶不上关停。这是Lisk自己的链退出安排，并非以太坊主网停止运行，也不是所有ETH持有人都必须移动资产。Lisk状态页显示10月30日主网及跨链相关组件仍为运行状态，不能把“计划关停”写成已经故障或资产已丢失。

这件事影响加密市场的方式主要是基础设施与流动性，而不是自动产生ETH买盘。跨链提款需要在以太坊主网完成证明和领取交易，用户还须准备少量主网ETH付手续费；若流动性提供者退出池子，局部交易深度可能变薄。迁移到主网的资产多数只是换了托管或使用位置，并不等于新增净需求。更值得警惕的是假冒迁移链接和索取助记词的诈骗，官方明确提醒只通过自查域名进入桥接页面。临近截止日才开始操作的人，应以官方最新公告和实际交易状态为准，不能把预计8天当成到账承诺。

价格层面也没有出现足以让我追价的确认。北京时间10月31日零点四十分左右，Kraken ETH/USD约2229.6美元，低于当日开盘2248.9美元；滚动24小时低点2170美元、高点2357.7美元。这个宽区间说明波动风险仍大，不能把Lisk迁移新闻解释成当下ETH涨跌的单一原因。我观察2260美元能否重新站稳，随后才看2300至2350美元；下方2170美元是明显风险参考。若价格跌破2170且反抽无力，短线偏多判断就被推翻。上述价格是当时的交易所快照，实际触发前必须重新核对。

如果是我自己交易，我暂时不参与，方向上只考虑确认后的现货小仓试多，不做高杠杆。条件是ETH一小时收在2260美元上方、回踩2245美元不破，并且BTC未同步失守自己的关键支撑；满足后首笔用账户资金的3%，最多加到6%。到2300美元先减半，到2350美元再平剩余仓位；若跌回2210美元，无论Lisk新闻如何解读都止损平仓。若先跌破2170美元，我取消多头计划，等新的结构形成。没有触发就保持空仓，绝不把计划写成已经买入或盈利。

title: Curve открыл филиал на Stellar 🌌. А как же Ethereum?
subTitle:
Curve выходит за пределы Ethereum-мира 🚀
Представьте: кофейня, которую все знают в вашем районе, вдруг открывает точку в другом городе. Примерно это сделал Curve.
Curve, один из самых известных обменников в мире DeFi, всегда работал на блокчейнах, которые «говорят на одном языке» (технически это EVM, язык Ethereum). Новый запуск на Stellar стал первым случаем, когда код Curve работает напрямую на блокчейне вне EVM. 
Что это значит для обычного человека?
Curve специализируется на обмене стейблкоинов, то есть монет, привязанных к доллару и другим валютам. Теперь такие обмены можно делать прямо в Stellar, без кросс-чейн мостов. Мосты часто бывают неудобными и рискованными, поэтому без них проще и спокойнее. 
Почему именно Stellar?
Stellar давно заточен под быстрые и дешёвые переводы денег. Основатель Curve Майкл Егоров объяснил, что Stellar ближе к привычному EVM-миру, чем многие другие блокчейны. Он также сказал, что решение отчасти продиктовано спросом со стороны институциональных игроков, то есть крупных финансовых компаний. Глава Stellar Development Foundation Денель Диксон добавила: стейблкоины и токенизированные активы приносят реальную пользу, только когда их можно эффективно обменивать. 
А как же Ethereum?
Спокойно, никто никого не бросал. Ethereum остаётся основным домом Curve, там живёт почти вся ликвидность. Stellar — это новая точка роста, как филиал популярной кофейни в соседнем районе: главный офис на месте, просто стало больше способов до него добраться.
Что дальше?
В планах FXSwap, он нацелен на рынок валютного обмена в блокчейне. Это как обмен валют в обменнике, только без обменника и с блокчейном внутри. 
Небольшая ложка скепсиса: на всех блокчейнах вне Ethereum у Curve сейчас меньше 46 млн долларов TVL (около 4% от общего). Так что успех Stellar ещё предстоит доказать. Эти цифры взяты из независимого разбора на GitHub, поэтому относитесь к ним как к оценке, а не к официальным данным. 
Кстати, в тот же день MetaMask сделал Stellar сетью по умолчанию, так что у запуска хороший попутный ветер.

📰 Short-term BTC holders sell at a loss for the first time in 72 days—what does this reveal?

Recent data shows that investors who have held Bitcoin for less than six months are starting to sell at a loss. This marks the first time since the start of this year that short-term holders have sold at a loss on paper. This shift may signal a subtle change in market sentiment. While it could mean Bitcoin's price is temporarily stabilizing, it could also bring pressure that triggers a larger sell-off.

Why does this news matter?
The behavior of short-term holders (typically those who have held for 1–3 months) often reflects short-term market sentiment. They are more sensitive to price fluctuations and tend to chase prices when they rise, then panic-sell when they fall. Selling at a loss this time suggests that Bitcoin's current price may have dropped below their mental stop-loss levels, possibly due to the recent sustained price decline ($77.6K, down 4.71% in 24 hours), which has put them under pressure. This is especially worth watching during periods of sharp market volatility, as it may suggest that selling pressure has not yet fully eased.

Market impact
Historically, the behavior of short-term holders has had some correlation with Bitcoin's subsequent price movements. If this reflects a concentrated wave of market panic, more buying may be needed in the short term to absorb the selling pressure; otherwise, prices may remain under pressure. But if this is a release of pent-up fear, it could instead build up buying power for later. This means Bitcoin's short-term trajectory may become more complicated, and it will be important to watch for large-scale capital inflows that could change the current weak trend.

Trading outlook
For now, short-term holders selling at a loss is more of an indicator of market sentiment than a direct buy or sell signal. It suggests that there is some selling pressure in the market, but it is not enough to conclude that Bitcoin is about to crash. More importantly, if Bitcoin finds support at a key price level soon (for example, around $75K), alongside a rise in trading volume, this could signal a temporary easing of short-term selling pressure.

最近数据显示，持有比特币不到半年的投资者开始出现亏损离场的情况。这标志着自今年初以来，首次有短期持币者因账面浮亏而卖出。这个变化可能预示着市场情绪的微妙转变，不排除比特币价格暂时企稳的可能性，但也存在引发更大规模抛售的压力。

为什么这条新闻重要？
短期持币者（通常指持仓1-3个月）的行为往往反映市场短期情绪。他们更敏感于价格波动，通常在上涨时追高，下跌时恐慌离场。这次亏损离场说明当前比特币价格可能已经跌破他们的心理止损位，这可能是由于近期价格持续下跌（$77.6K 24小时-4.71%），让他们感到压力。这个现象在市场经历剧烈波动时尤为值得关注，因为它可能暗示着抛压并未完全释放完毕。

对市场的影响
从历史来看，短期持币者的行为与比特币后续走势存在一定关联。如果这是市场恐慌情绪的集中体现，那么短期内可能需要更多买盘来消化这些抛售压力，否则价格可能继续承压。但如果这是恐慌情绪的宣泄，反而可能为后续的买盘积累弹药。这意味着短期内比特币的走势可能更加复杂，需要关注是否有大规模资金介入来改变当前的弱势格局。

操作思路
目前来看，短期持币者的亏损离场更像是一个市场情绪的观察点，而非直接的买卖信号。它提示我们，当前市场存在一定的抛售压力，但并不足以说明比特币即将崩盘。更值得关注的是，如果比特币价格能在近期某个关键价位（例如$75K附近）获得支撑，并伴随成交量放大，那么这可能预示着短期抛压的阶段性缓解。

如果未来几天比特币价格继续下跌并跌破$75K，那么这个判断作废。

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

Bitcoin has fallen below the $80,000 mark, reflecting the macroeconomic pressures facing the cryptocurrency market amid continued Federal Reserve rate hikes and a flight to safety in the stablecoin market. For investors, this means reassessing their allocation to risk assets, especially in a tense global interest rate environment.

Why does this news matter?
Bitcoin’s decline highlights the cryptocurrency market’s sensitivity to macroeconomic factors. As the Federal Reserve raises interest rates to combat inflation, investors’ money is beginning to flow into assets considered safer, such as Treasury bonds. In addition, recent concerns about a potential run on stablecoins like USDT have further fueled risk aversion. Together, these factors have dampened risk appetite and put downward pressure on the prices of major cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin.

Market impact
In the short term, Bitcoin’s fall below $80,000 could trigger more technical selling, especially if it breaks below key support levels. However, if the Fed’s rate hikes slow global economic growth, Bitcoin’s safe-haven qualities as “digital gold” may emerge later on. Historically, Bitcoin has performed poorly during rate-hiking cycles, but has often found support during economic recessions.

Trading approach
At present, Bitcoin’s fall below $80,000 indicates that market sentiment is bearish, and investors should remain cautious. If the Federal Reserve continues to tighten monetary policy, Bitcoin may fall further. However, if the economy proves weaker than expected, Bitcoin could rebound on safe-haven demand. title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100U control 1000U, and what’s the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people who are just getting started ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you earn 10 times as much? Today, I’ll explain it in plain English.

【The basics】Leverage means the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100U of your own and use 10x leverage, you’re actually controlling a
1000U position. If the coin’s price rises by 1%, you make 10% on your principal; conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss on your principal—note, the loss is calculated based on the total position you borrowed to trade.

【The cost】With 10x leverage, if the coin’s price moves against you by about 10%, your principal is wiped out. This is called liquidation. It’s not
that it has to drop 10% before you lose everything; at around a 10% drop, it’s all gone (the exact threshold also depends on the margin ratio).

ETH fell 5.80% in 24 hours to 2228.27. Anyone can read that number. The truly informative signal is the 8h funding rate flipping to -0.0036%—Binance perpetuals have a baseline of +0.0100%. Going from the baseline to negative, a swing of 1.36 basis points, is no mere fluctuation; it’s a directional reversal.

First, shorts are starting to pay out of pocket to hold their positions. A negative funding rate means perpetuals are trading at a discount to spot, so short sellers have to pay longs a fee every 8 hours. Using the $5.282 billion in open interest for a rough estimate, shorts collectively pay about $190,000 per settlement, nearly $570,000 a day across three settlements, which works out to an annualized holding cost of about 3.9%. Shorts willing to pay to hold a position that has already fallen 5.8% have only two possible explanations: they believe the downside potential far outweighs that cost, or they’re being forced to maintain a hedge. Put another way, that money is flowing to longs every day—right now, holding a long position means not only paying no interest, but collecting a fee.

Second, perpetuals aren’t driving the sell-off. Of the 17.16 billion USDT in 24-hour trading volume, it’s selling in the spot and lending markets that’s really pushing prices down. Perpetual shorts look more like traders chasing the move lower. That distinction matters: spot sellers have a defined supply and an endpoint; once they’ve finished selling, they’re done. Chasing shorts have no endpoint—just sentiment and costs. When spot selling pressure dries up, the shorts paying a fee become the most vulnerable link in the structure.

Third, account positioning is split. 74.8% of accounts are long, yet the funding rate is negative—the majority by account count are collecting fees, while the minority by capital deployed are paying them. This combination often appears after a sharp drop: retail longs are stuck above 2228 and unwilling to cut losses, while larger players are pressing shorts in derivatives. This should be read as fertile ground for wide swings in both directions, not as a one-way trend.

Fourth, the narrative hasn’t been resolved. The discrepancies in estimates of the amount stolen are themselves a source of volatility—the $5.9 billion estimate, the remaining shortfall even after deducting the $2.4 billion in frozen stablecoins, and the gap between those figures and the official account. The market won’t finish pricing in this accounting in a day or two. This is the main force currently capping a rebound, and it’s also why negative funding can persist: shorts have a story that makes sense.

My view: at 2228, the funding-rate signal is stronger than the price itself. A spot-driven sell-off combined with negative funding means shorts are paying to maintain a position that has already fallen considerably. That’s overcrowding, not composure. If funding stays negative or turns even more negative, I’ll be watching to see whether spot selling dries up—that’s more useful than guessing where the bottom is. The risk is a downward wick: with 74.8% of accounts long, the price could absolutely get uglier first before the shorts have to pay.

It’s your own money on the line with your position, but everyone can see the funding rate. Don’t be the last short standing when the rent is at its highest.

第一，空头开始自己掏钱扛单。负费率意味着永续对现货贴水，做空方每 8 小时要给多头付一次租金。按 52.82 亿美元持仓量粗算，一次结算空头集体付出约 19 万美元，一天三次接近 57 万，折年化约 3.9% 的持有成本。空头愿意为一个已经跑出 5.8% 跌幅的仓位倒贴钱，逻辑上只有两种：他们认为下方空间远大于这笔开支，或者他们被迫维持对冲。反过来讲，这笔钱每天都在给多头输血——现在拿多头不但不付利息，还在收租。

第二，砸盘的手不在永续。24 小时 171.6 亿 USDT 的成交额里，真正把价格压下去的是现货和借贷端的卖盘，永续空头更像是顺着往下追的人。这个区别很关键：现货卖盘有明确货源和终点，出货出完就没了；追空没有终点，只有情绪和成本。当现货抛压衰竭，付着租金的空头就是结构里最脆弱的一环。

第三，账户结构在分裂。74.8% 的账户是多头，费率却是负的——账户数的多数派在收租，资金量的少数派在付租。这种组合往往出现在急跌之后：小散多头被套在 2228 上方不肯砍，大资金在衍生品端压空。它应该被解读为双向宽幅波动的温床，而非单边趋势形态。

第四，叙事还没出清。被盗规模的口径差本身就是波动源——59 亿的估算、扣掉被冻结的 24 亿稳定币后仍有缺口、跟官方说法之间的悬空部分，市场对这套账的定价不会一两天完成。这是目前压住反弹的主要力量，也是负费率能维持下去的理由：空头手里有个讲得通的故事。

我的判断：在 2228 这个位置，费率的信号强度高于价格本身。现货主导的砸盘加负费率，说明空头在付费维持一个已经跌了不少的仓位，这是拥挤，不是从容。接下来如果费率继续停在负值甚至走深，我会盯着现货卖盘有没有枯竭，这比猜底在哪更有用。风险在于下行插针——74.8% 的多头账户摆在那儿，价格完全可能先更难看一段，然后才轮到空头付账。

仓位的钱是自己的，费率是所有人一起看的，别在租金最贵的时候去做最后一个空头。

title: 交易干货 | 满仓一把梭的数学期望，看完你还敢吗
subTitle:
假设一个策略胜率60%，对了赚50%，错了亏50%。听上去不错吧？
如果每次满仓，算一下长期结果：60%×50% - 40%×50% = 每笔期望+10%，
看着是正期望。但注意路径：连错两次就是-75%，需要+300%才能回本。
正期望的策略+满仓执行=大概率破产，这就是赌徒破产定理在币圈的
日常上演。

同样的策略，改成每次只动20%仓位：连错两次-18%，毫无杀伤力，
长期期望照吃。策略没变，变的只是仓位，生死就不同。

记住这个不等式：你的长期收益 ≈ 策略期望 × 你能活多久。仓位决定
后者。活得久的人，才有资格谈期望值。

translatedData.title: Trading Insights | The Math of Going All In—Would You Still Dare After Reading This?
translatedData.subTitle:
Suppose a strategy has a 60% win rate, earning 50% when you’re right and losing 50% when you’re wrong. Sounds good, right?
If you go all in every time, let’s calculate the long-term result: 60% × 50% - 40% × 50% = an expected gain of 10% per trade,
It looks like a positive expected return. But consider the path: two losses in a row means -75%, and you need a +300% return just to break even.
A positive-expectation strategy + going all in = a high probability of ruin. This is the gambler’s ruin theorem playing out in crypto
every day.

Same strategy, but only use 20% of your capital each time: two losses in a row means -18%, hardly a devastating hit,
and you still capture the long-term expected returns. The strategy hasn’t changed—only your position size has, but the outcome is life or death.
